lookup.why: IOSurfaceRoot::lookupSurface(id, task): find_surface, then a try-retain of +0xc; the first IOSurface entry of AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver's GOT (0xfffffff006e5e910)

plane_width.why: getPlaneWidth(plane): plane entry +0x00 (stride 0x38), the plane array at +0x180 and the count at +0x98 checked first

plane_height.why: getPlaneHeight(plane): add x8, x8, #0x8 at +0x80, the entry's height

plane_offset.why: getPlaneOffset(plane): add x8, x8, #0x18 at +0x80, the entry's offset

plane_bytes_per_row.why: getPlaneBytesPerRow(plane): add x8, x8, #0x20 at +0x80, the entry's bytes per row

device_unlock.why: the device write end (surface, options): under the surface's IOLock (+0x50), unless options bit 0 (read), the seed (+0xc of the root entry at +0x178) and the write count (+0x10) go up and the cache flags (+0x3b0) get 0x1c; returns 0. AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver's GOT holds it at 0xfffffff006e5ea88: what Apple's media engines call on a job's destination

copy_value.why: IOSurface::copyValue(OSSymbol const*, uint32_t*): takes the surface lock at +0x50, calls the retained dictionary-value accessor with key and seed output, then unlocks; the same wrapper around copyValue as 21H461

bytes_per_element.why: ldrh w0, [x0, #0x70]: IOSurfaceBytesPerElement; constructor stores the parsed property at this field

element_width.why: ldrb w0, [x0, #0x72]: IOSurfaceElementWidth; constructor stores the parsed property at this field

element_height.why: ldrb w0, [x0, #0x73]: IOSurfaceElementHeight; constructor stores the parsed property at this field

use_count_increment.why: IOSurface::incrementUseCount(category): category above 1 refused, +0x3b2 bit 5 (kIOSurfaceProhibitUseCount) logs "Attempt to change IOSurface useCount while kIOSurfaceProhibitUseCount is set, ignored.", else an exclusive add of 1 to the low (category 0) or high word at +0x18 of the shared entry (+0x178), up the parent chain (+0x358); selector 14 reaches it (0xfffffff005bae1bc via 0xfffffff005bb0624); the wrapper at 0xfffffff005b9f750 (mov w1, #0) is AppleAVE2's GOT entry 0xfffffff006f79e80

use_count_decrement.why: IOSurface::decrementUseCount(category): the same checks, an exclusive take of 1 from the category's word at +0x18 (never below 0); selector 15 reaches it (0xfffffff005bae1cc via 0xfffffff005bb06c4); the wrapper at 0xfffffff005b9f80c is GOT entry 0xfffffff006f79e70, 0x10 before the increment's as in 24B119's AppleAVE2

use_count.why: IOSurface::getUseCount(): the shared entry's +0x18 low and high words added; selector 16 (0xfffffff005bae1dc) returns it; GOT entry 0xfffffff006f79ec8

seed.why: IOSurface::getSeed(): ldr x8, [x0, #0x178] (the shared entry); ldr w0, [x8, #0xc]: the word IOSurface::lock (0xfffffff005b9d81c), the device write end (0xfffffff005ba0ff4), the allocation over client memory (0xfffffff005b9c408) and the seed increment pair (0xfffffff005b9d6b4, 0xfffffff005b9d704) add 1 to; between the +0x3b2 flag readers and the +0x10 reader, the accessor run 24B119 has at 0xfffffff009af6940. The 0xb8-byte shared entry is zeroed when made (0xfffffff005bac818..834)

baseOffset.why: ldr x0, [x0, #0x168]: the accessor the map-into-task adds to the map's address; IOGPUFamily's newResourceWithIOSurface imports it

clientMemory.why: ldr x8, [x0, #0x150] in the client's map-into-task: when set and the surface's +0x170 is the client's task, the client takes this address and maps nothing

clientTask.why: ldr x9, [x0, #0x170] in the map-into-task, compared with the client's task

useCountFlags.why: ldrb w11, [x0, #0x3b2] then tbnz w11, #5 in incrementUseCount: the prohibit flag every use-count change tests (24B119: +0x3d2)

parent.why: ldr x8, [x0, #0x358] at the head of the memory allocation init calls (0xfffffff005b999e4): a child takes its parent's descriptor (+0x30 of the parent) and no seed moves; the use counts climb the same chain (24B119: +0x378)

memoryRegions.why: ldr x8, [x19, #0x350] in the memory allocation when clientMemory is 0: each 16-byte range of the creating task (+0x170) is checked page-aligned and the descriptor made over them (0xfffffff005b9c5b0), with no seed move, unlike the clientMemory branch (0xfffffff005b9c408) (24B119: +0x370)
